description: React component for an advanced date range picker with relative time options, custom date inputs, validation, and dropdown UI.

classes.name: AdvancedDatePickerProps
classes.description: Props interface for the AdvancedDatePicker component, including value, change handler, label, className, and showTimeRange.

classes.name: RelativeTimeOption
classes.description: Interface for relative time options with label, shortLabel, and getValue method.

methods.name: getMatchingOption
methods.description: Checks if current date range matches any predefined relative time options.

methods.name: validateDateRange
methods.description: Validates start and end date inputs for correct format and logical order.

methods.name: formatDisplayRange
methods.description: Formats the displayed date range string for UI.

methods.name: adjustDateRange
methods.description: Adjusts date range to start/end of day, with special handling for same-day ranges.

methods.name: handleRelativeTimeSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a relative time preset, updating temporary value and UI.

methods.name: updateTempValueFromInputs
methods.description: Updates temporary date range value based on manual date input fields.

methods.name: handleApply
methods.description: Applies the selected date range, performing immediate update and background adjustment.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets temporary inputs and closes the dropdown without applying changes.
